title: Petition of Eastern Edison Company for authorization and approval by the Department of Public Utilities of (1) the execution of one or more loan agreements by Eastern Edison Company with the Massachusetts Industries Finance Agency or a similar agency with tax-exempt bonding authority in an amount not to exceed $40,000,000, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 14; (2) the issuance by Eastern Edison Company of one or more series of First Mortgage and Collateral Trust Bonds; (3) the execution by Eastern Edison Company of a letter of credit and reimbursement agreement; (4) the execution of related financing and security agreements; and (5) an exemption from the competitive bidding provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 15; and (6) an exemption from the par value provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 15A.
